digest.component_or_area: rebar init store-mount / branch bootstrap gate
propositions: A failed or timed-out tickets-branch fetch causes rebar init to silently create an empty orphan divergent store instead of failing closed.
Branch-existence detection relies only on local refs and remote-tracking refs, so it cannot distinguish an unreachable remote from a genuinely absent branch.
A shared tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote --exit-code should classify advertised, reachable-absent, and unreachable, and be consumed by all init-mount code paths.
When the remote advertises the branch but fetch fails, init must return nonzero without creating an orphan branch.
When the remote is unreachable or times out, init must fail closed with a distinct diagnostic unless an explicit --force-new-store / force_new_store override is supplied.
The tri-state probe result is cached with a short TTL keyed by repo, remote, and branch so one CLI invocation performs at most one probe on the unreachable path.
